name: Le Colline del Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene
description: In the hills of north-eastern Italy's Veneto region, between the towns of Conegliano and Valdobbiadene, steep, narrow ridges are stitched with rows of vines. Since the 17th century, farmers have planted them on grassy terraces called ciglioni, creating a chequerboard pattern among woods, villages and fields. This is the home of Prosecco Superiore, Italy's celebrated sparkling white wine.
